bottom_line.paragraph: The index is falling while the average stock rises: SPY lost 1.73% over the five sessions to 2 Nov while the equal-weight AQE list made +1.08%, and breadth is broadening near the top of its 12-month range. Valen reads RISK OFF and a DOWNTREND, and dealers are short gamma with SPY 752.1 sitting just above the 750 put wall, so a break of 750 hits every long at once. The slate is Staples, Financials and Healthcare leaders at or near new highs; only PFE was agreed without objection.
